not_planted.K9: A second K9 would be a lock version that contradicts its manifest pin; it waits for the first grading run.

declared.text: Request fields are passed to helpers as argument-vector entries, never as shell text.

faults.finding: The archive name is interpolated into a shell command despite the argv declaration.

neighbour.why_clean: The checksum helper passes its path as one entry in a subprocess argument list.

declared.text: Served files always resolve beneath the store root.

faults.finding: The record path joins an untrusted name without checking containment under the root.

neighbour.why_clean: The checked resolver proves the resolved candidate is relative to the root.

declared.text: Credentials never enter the request log.

faults.finding: The request logger writes all headers, including the authorization credential.

neighbour.why_clean: The neighbouring logger emits a fixed redaction marker instead of the credential.

declared.text: A malformed request is refused with a problem, never answered as empty success.

faults.finding: The request boundary swallows parse failures and serves an authoritative empty success.

neighbour.why_clean: The missing-field path catches KeyError and returns an explicit problem object.

declared.text: Pages are half-open: the start is included and the stop excluded.

faults.finding: The page slice adds one to stop and therefore includes the declared exclusive end.

neighbour.why_clean: The page-count helper uses a half-open range with total as its stop.

declared.text: Tests exercise the real request parser at the boundary.

faults.finding: The boundary refusal test replaces the parser and therefore proves the stub rather than real input.

neighbour.why_clean: The neighbouring parser test calls parse_request directly on a literal request.

declared.text: Runtime dependencies are pinned to one version in the manifest and the lock agrees.

faults.finding: The runtime manifest admits a version range although the lock names one release.

neighbour.why_clean: The sibling runtime dependency is pinned to exactly version 1.0.1.
